haiku.problem: This is a False card, but the explanation never states what the text says. It only restates Paul's question and adds "Nobody in Corinth could say yes to that one," which is not in the BSB text. The text itself asserts that Christ is not divided and that Paul was not crucified for them.

The explanation reverses the order of the BSB text. In 1 Corinthians 1:20, the "Where is the wise man?" questions come first and "Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?" comes after them, but the explanation says he asks the "Has not" question "right after" the "Where" questions.
